verdict.rationale: Raygun docs show rule-based alerting integrations (e.g., PagerDuty incidents created 'when an issue is triggered from this rule', Slack channel routing for APM traces) and 'Ignore by rule' conditions for error statuses, indicating some rule/condition-based automatic action triggering exists. However, there's no documentation of a general-purpose rule engine, custom event triggers, or a broad set of automatable actions beyond alert routing/ignoring. Missing for 10: comprehensive rule-builder documentation, variety of trigger conditions/events beyond error occurrence, breadth of automatable actions, and independent confirmation of reliability.
